about.featuresDesc: Laku POS is a modern warehouse and point of sale management system built with Next.js 16, tRPC, and Supabase. Equipped with real-time analytics, multi-payment, barcode scanning, offline mode, and subscription management for retail businesses of all sizes.
about.features.dashboard.item1: Real-time revenue & sales statistics with Nivo line chart
about.features.dashboard.item4: Low stock alerts with severity indicators
about.features.warehouseMgmt.item2: Auto-fill opening stock from previous day
about.features.warehouseMgmt.item4: Low stock threshold alerts (configurable per product)
about.features.warehouseMgmt.item6: Export stock reports to CSV & PDF
about.features.pos.item1: Cart drawer layout — no scroll, distraction-free cashier UI
about.features.pos.item3: 6 payment methods: Cash, QRIS, Bank Transfer, Debit, Credit Card, E-Wallet
about.features.pos.item5: Thermal receipt printing (80mm) with cashier info
about.features.pos.item6: Sales history with advanced filtering & timeline
about.features.reports.item1: Revenue trend charts: Nivo (dashboard) + Recharts Line/Bar/Area
about.features.reports.item6: Per-outlet filtering across all report pages
about.features.master.item1: Product management with SKU, barcode field & categories
about.features.master.item2: Bulk product import from Excel/CSV with preview & validation
about.features.userMgmt.item1: JWT authentication with 7-day sessions & email verification
about.features.userMgmt.item2: Role-based access control: Admin / Manager / User
about.features.userMgmt.item3: Subscription plans: Free / Warung / Starter / Professional / Business / Enterprise
about.features.userMgmt.item4: 14-day auto trial for Starter plan upon registration
about.features.userMgmt.item5: Plan enforcement: outlets, cashiers, export & PWA install gating
about.features.pwa.item3: Auto-sync every 30 seconds when back online
